<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id" data-theme="dark">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Nizar Sabri Al Qodari — Portfolio</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#080d1a;--bg2:#0d1221;--card:#111827;--card2:#161e30;--border:#1a2844;--border2:#213256;--text:#e4eaf4;--text2:#8fa3c0;--text3:#4d6485;--accent:#38bdf8;--accent3:#7dd3fc;--green:#4ade80;--purple:#a78bfa;--pink:#f472b6;--amber:#fbbf24;--red:#f87171;--glow:0 0 24px rgba(56,189,248,.2),0 0 60px rgba(56,189,248,.06);--glow2:0 0 32px rgba(56,189,248,.45);}
:root[data-theme="light"]{--bg:#f0f5ff;--bg2:#e6eeff;--card:#fff;--card2:#f4f8ff;--border:#c5d4ee;--border2:#a8bfe0;--text:#0f1a2e;--text2:#3a527a;--text3:#6b84aa;--accent:#0284c7;--accent3:#38bdf8;--green:#16a34a;--purple:#7c3aed;--pink:#db2777;--amber:#d97706;--red:#dc2626;--glow:0 0 24px rgba(2,132,199,.12);--glow2:0 0 32px rgba(2,132,199,.25);}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);line-height:1.6;overflow-x:hidden;transition:background .3s,color .3s;}
body::after{content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(var(--border) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--border) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:60px 60px;opacity:.1;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;}
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:1000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:.8rem 1.5rem;background:rgba(8,13,26,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);transition:background .3s;}
[data-theme="light"] nav{background:rgba(240,245,255,.9);}
.nav-brand{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;}
.nav-brand span{color:var(--text3);}
.nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;}
.nav-link{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.66rem;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid transparent;color:var(--text3);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;background:transparent;}
.nav-link:hover{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--border2);}
.nav-link.active{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);background:rgba(56,189,248,.08);}
.nav-right{display:flex;gap:6px;}
.ctrl{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.68rem;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border2);background:var(--card);color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;}
.ctrl:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);}
.page{display:none;position:relative;z-index:1;min-height:100vh;padding-top:60px;}
.page.active{display:block;}
#page-home{display:none;align-items:center;}
#page-home.active{display:flex;}
.container{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem;}
.hero-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 270px;gap:3rem;align-items:center;width:100%;padding:3rem 0;}
.terminal{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:1.5rem;box-shadow:var(--glow);overflow:hidden;}
.terminal-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 12px;background:var(--card2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.td{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;}.td.r{background:#ff5f56;}.td.y{background:#ffbd2e;}.td.g{background:#27c93f;}
.tbt{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.68rem;color:var(--text3);margin-left:6px;}
.terminal-body{padding:1.1rem 1.4rem;}
.term-row{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.82rem;display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.t-prompt{color:var(--green);}.t-path{color:var(--purple);}.t-dollar{color:var(--text3);}.t-cmd{color:var(--accent);}
.t-cursor{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:15px;background:var(--accent);animation:blink 1s step-end infinite;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:1px;}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:0}}
.hero-greeting{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--text3);font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;margin-bottom:.4rem;}
.hero-name{font-size:clamp(2rem,4.5vw,3.6rem);font-weight:800;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin-bottom:.9rem;}
.hero-name .hl{color:var(--accent);text-shadow:var(--glow2);}
.hero-sub{font-size:.95rem;color:var(--text2);max-width:460px;margin-bottom:1.5rem;}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:1.75rem;}
.tag{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.65rem;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(56,189,248,.08);color:var(--accent);border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.18);}
.btns{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.btn-solid{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;padding:9px 22px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent);color:#060d1a;border:1px solid var(--accent);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;transition:all .2s;}
.btn-solid:hover{background:var(--accent3);box-shadow:var(--glow2);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.btn-ghost{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;padding:9px 22px;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--text2);border:1px solid var(--border2);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;transition:all .2s;}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.avatar-wrap{position:relative;width:250px;height:250px;flex-shrink:0;}
.av-ring{position:absolute;inset:-12px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid transparent;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--purple)) border-box;-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) padding-box,linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);-webkit-mask-composite:destination-out;mask-composite:exclude;animation:spin 9s linear infinite;}
.av-ring2{position:absolute;inset:-24px;border-radius:50%;border:1px dashed rgba(56,189,248,.2);animation:spin 20s linear infinite reverse;}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.av-circle{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;background:var(--card);border:1.5px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;}
.sec-eyebrow{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.68rem;color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.4rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.sec-eyebrow::before{content:'//';color:var(--text3);}
.sec-title{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.2rem);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:1.75rem;}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:1.6rem;transition:border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s;}
.card:hover{border-color:var(--border2);box-shadow:var(--glow);}
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.25rem;margin-bottom:1.5rem;}
.info-row{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:.6rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.info-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.ikey{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.68rem;color:var(--accent);min-width:85px;padding-top:3px;flex-shrink:0;}
.ival{font-size:.875rem;color:var(--text2);}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:.5rem;}
.chip{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.65rem;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid var(--border2);color:var(--text2);background:var(--card2);transition:all .2s;}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);}
.chip.g{border-color:rgba(74,222,128,.3);color:var(--green);background:rgba(74,222,128,.05);}
.chip.p{border-color:rgba(167,139,250,.3);color:var(--purple);background:rgba(167,139,250,.05);}
.chip.pk{border-color:rgba(244,114,182,.3);color:var(--pink);background:rgba(244,114,182,.05);}
.chip.a{border-color:rgba(251,191,36,.3);color:var(--amber);background:rgba(251,191,36,.05);}
.social-row{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:1.4rem;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.social-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border2);background:transparent;color:var(--text2);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s;}
.social-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.04);box-shadow:var(--glow2);}
.social-btn.ig:hover{border-color:#e1306c;color:#e1306c;background:rgba(225,48,108,.06);}
.social-btn.gh:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);}
.social-btn.li:hover{border-color:#0a66c2;color:#0a66c2;background:rgba(10,102,194,.06);}
.skill-level{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.68rem;color:var(--amber);letter-spacing:.1em;margin:1.1rem 0 .6rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.skill-level::before{content:'##';color:var(--text3);}
.skill-list{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;}
.skill-list li{font-size:.84rem;color:var(--text2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:.4rem .7rem;background:var(--card2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;transition:all .2s;}
.skill-list li:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--text);transform:translateX(4px);}
.skill-list li::before{content:'▸';color:var(--accent);font-size:.68rem;}
.proj-nav{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:1.75rem;}
.pnav{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.7rem;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--border2);background:transparent;color:var(--text3);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;}
.pnav:hover{color:var(--text2);}
.pnav.on{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);background:rgba(56,189,248,.08);box-shadow:var(--glow);}
.pcontent{display:none;}
.pcontent.on{display:block;animation:fadeup .3s ease;}
@keyframes fadeup{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.quote-box{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-left:3px solid var(--accent);border-radius:0 14px 14px 0;padding:1.75rem 2rem;box-shadow:var(--glow);}
.quote-meta{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.66rem;color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:.12em;margin-bottom:.9rem;}
#quote-el{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.9;font-style:italic;}
.tcursor{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1em;background:var(--accent);vertical-align:text-bottom;animation:blink .8s step-end infinite;margin-left:2px;}
.acc-item{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:9px;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s;}
.acc-item.open{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:var(--glow);}
.acc-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:.9rem 1.1rem;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s;user-select:none;}
.acc-head:hover{background:var(--card2);}
.acc-num{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.66rem;color:var(--accent);min-width:28px;}
.acc-title{font-size:.92rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);flex:1;}
.acc-arrow{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--text3);transition:transform .3s;}
.acc-item.open .acc-arrow{transform:rotate(180deg);}
.acc-body{display:none;padding:0 1.4rem 1.4rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);}
.acc-item.open .acc-body{display:block;}
.acc-desc{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.75;margin:1.1rem 0 .9rem;}
.acc-section{margin-top:1.1rem;}
.acc-section h4{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--amber);letter-spacing:.08em;margin-bottom:.6rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
.acc-section h4::before{content:'##';color:var(--text3);}
.step-list{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;}
.step-list li{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:.83rem;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.6;}
.step-num{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.65rem;background:rgba(56,189,248,.1);color:var(--accent);border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 5px;min-width:24px;text-align:center;margin-top:2px;flex-shrink:0;}
.code-wrap{position:relative;margin:.7rem 0;}
.code-block{background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border2);border-radius:8px;padding:.9rem 1.1rem;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--green);line-height:1.8;overflow-x:auto;}
.code-block pre{white-space:pre;word-break:normal;}
.copy-btn{position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.62rem;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid var(--border2);background:var(--card2);color:var(--text3);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;}
.copy-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);}
.copy-btn.copied{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green);}
.note-box{background:rgba(167,139,250,.07);border-left:3px solid var(--purple);border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;padding:.7rem .9rem;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text2);margin:.7rem 0;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}
.tip-box{background:rgba(74,222,128,.07);border-left:3px solid var(--green);border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;padding:.7rem .9rem;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text2);margin:.7rem 0;}
.script-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(235px,1fr));gap:6px;}
.scard{background:var(--card2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;padding:.5rem .85rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;transition:all .2s;}
.scard:hover{border-color:var(--purple);background:rgba(167,139,250,.05);transform:translateX(3px);}
.sdot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--purple);flex-shrink:0;}
.stxt{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.74rem;color:var(--text2);}
.cert-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:1.5rem;margin-bottom:1.25rem;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s;}
.cert-card:hover{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:var(--glow);}
.cert-title{font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:.4rem;}
.cert-issuer{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:1rem;}
.cert-pdf{width:100%;height:500px;border:none;border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg2);}
.cert-dl{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.72rem;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border2);color:var(--text2);text-decoration:none;margin-top:.75rem;transition:all .2s;}
.cert-dl:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);}
background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:1.75rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s;}
.rand-card:hover{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:var(--glow);}
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:1.75rem;text-align:center;position:relative;z-index:1;}
.f-email{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--accent);text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer;display:inline-block;}
.f-email:hover{opacity:.7;text-decoration:underline;}
.f-copy{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--text3);margin-top:6px;}
.fi{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);transition:opacity .5s ease,transform .5s ease;}
.fi.in{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px;}::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg);}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border2);border-radius:3px;}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--accent);}
@media(max-width:768px){.hero-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.avatar-wrap{width:160px;height:160px;margin:0 auto;order:-1;}.about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}nav{padding:.65rem 1rem;}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<nav>
  <span class="nav-brand" onclick="showPage('home')"><span>~/</span>nizar<span>@</span>portfolio</span>
  <div class="nav-links">
    <button class="nav-link active" id="nl-home"    onclick="showPage('home')"    data-id="nl-home">~Home</button>
    <button class="nav-link"        id="nl-about"   onclick="showPage('about')"   data-id="nl-about">About</button>
    <button class="nav-link"        id="nl-project" onclick="showPage('project')" data-id="nl-proj">My Project</button>
  </div>
  <div class="nav-right">
    <button class="ctrl" id="lang-btn"  onclick="toggleLang()">&#127760; EN</button>
    <button class="ctrl" id="theme-btn" onclick="toggleTheme()">&#9728;&#65039; Light</button>
  </div>
</nav>

<div class="page active" id="page-home">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="hero-wrap">
      <div>
        <div class="terminal">
          <div class="terminal-bar">
            <div class="td r"></div><div class="td y"></div><div class="td g"></div>
            <span class="tbt">bash &#8212; nizar@portfolio:~</span>
          </div>
          <div class="terminal-body">
            <div class="term-row">
              <span class="t-prompt">nizar</span><span class="t-dollar">@</span><span class="t-path">portfolio</span><span class="t-dollar">:~$</span>
              <span class="t-cmd" id="term-txt"></span><span class="t-cursor"></span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p class="hero-greeting" data-id="h-greet">Halo, nama saya</p>
        <h1 class="hero-name"><span class="hl">Nizar Sabri</span><br>Al Qodari</h1>
        <div class="tags">
          <span class="tag" data-id="t1">Network Engineering</span>
          <span class="tag" data-id="t2">AI Engineer</span>
          <span class="tag" data-id="t3">Programmer</span>
          <span class="tag" data-id="t4">Fresh Graduate</span>
        </div>
        <p class="hero-sub" data-id="h-sub">Fresh Graduated Network Engineering Student, Hobbyist Programmer &amp; AI Engineer yang antusias belajar teknologi.</p>
        <div class="btns">
          <button class="btn-solid" onclick="showPage('about')"   data-id="h-btn1">&#128196; Learn More</button>
          <button class="btn-ghost" onclick="showPage('project')" data-id="h-btn2">&#128187; My Project</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="avatar-wrap">
        <div class="av-ring"></div><div class="av-ring2"></div>
        <div class="av-circle">
          <svg width="220" height="220" viewBox="0 0 220 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
            <rect width="220" height="220" fill="var(--card)"/>
            <rect x="25" y="45" width="170" height="105" rx="9" fill="var(--bg2)" stroke="var(--border2)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <rect x="25" y="45" width="170" height="20" rx="8" fill="var(--border)"/>
            <circle cx="40" cy="55" r="4" fill="#ff5f56"/><circle cx="54" cy="55" r="4" fill="#ffbd2e"/><circle cx="68" cy="55" r="4" fill="#27c93f"/>
            <rect x="40" y="80" width="50" height="4" rx="2" fill="#38bdf8" opacity=".9"/>
            <rect x="40" y="92" width="90" height="4" rx="2" fill="#a78bfa" opacity=".8"/>
            <rect x="40" y="104" width="60" height="4" rx="2" fill="#4ade80" opacity=".85"/>
            <rect x="40" y="116" width="75" height="4" rx="2" fill="#f472b6" opacity=".65"/>
            <rect x="40" y="128" width="45" height="4" rx="2" fill="#38bdf8" opacity=".55"/>
            <rect x="40" y="138" width="9" height="7" rx="1" fill="#38bdf8"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0;1" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect>
            <rect x="100" y="150" width="20" height="12" rx="2" fill="var(--border)"/>
            <rect x="83" y="162" width="54" height="6" rx="3" fill="var(--border2)"/>
            <circle cx="110" cy="196" r="17" fill="var(--card2)" stroke="var(--border2)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <circle cx="110" cy="189" r="7.5" fill="var(--text3)"/>
            <path d="M93 211 Q110 200 127 211" stroke="var(--text3)" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            <text x="177" y="43" font-size="13" fill="#38bdf8" opacity=".75" font-family="monospace">&#x2B21;</text>
            <text x="18" y="42" font-size="11" fill="#a78bfa" opacity=".7" font-family="monospace">{}</text>
            <text x="172" y="185" font-size="10" fill="#4ade80" opacity=".75" font-family="monospace">&gt;_</text>
          </svg>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="page" id="page-about">
  <div class="container" style="padding-top:2.5rem;padding-bottom:4rem;">
    <div class="sec-eyebrow" data-id="ab-ey">Tentang Saya</div>
    <h2 class="sec-title" data-id="ab-title">Tentang Saya</h2>
    <div class="about-grid fi" id="about-cards">
      <div class="card">

var _lang='id',_theme='dark',_quoteTyped=false,_currentPage='home',_quoteTimer=null;
function showPage(name,scrollSkills){document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(function(p){p.classList.remove('active');});document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(function(n){n.classList.remove('active');});var pg=document.getElementById('page-'+name);if(pg)pg.classList.add('active');var nlId=name==='project'?'nl-project':name==='home'?'nl-home':'nl-about';var nl=document.getElementById(nlId);if(nl)nl.classList.add('active');_currentPage=name;window.scrollTo(0,0);if(name==='about'){setTimeout(function(){var c=document.getElementById('about-cards');if(c)c.classList.add('in');if(scrollSkills){var sk=document.getElementById('skills-card');if(sk)sk.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});}},80);}if(name==='project'&&!_quoteTyped)setTimeout(startQuote,200);}

function startQuote(){var q=QUOTES[_lang];var el=document.getElementById('quote-el');if(!el)return;if(_quoteTimer)clearTimeout(_quoteTimer);el.innerHTML='';var i=0;_quoteTyped=false;function step(){if(i<q.length){el.innerHTML=q.substring(0,++i)+'<span class="tcursor"></span>';_quoteTimer=setTimeout(step,65);}else{_quoteTyped=true;el.innerHTML=q+'<span class="tcursor"></span>';_quoteTimer=setTimeout(function(){el.innerHTML='';i=0;_quoteTyped=false;_quoteTimer=setTimeout(step,800);},3500);}}step();}
function startTerm(){var el=document.getElementById('term-txt');if(!el)return;var txt='cd /home/nizar';var i=0;el.textContent='';function step(){if(i<txt.length){el.textContent+=txt[i++];setTimeout(step,85);}}step();}
function toggleTheme(){_theme=_theme==='dark'?'light':'dark';document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme',_theme);var btn=document.getElementById('theme-btn');if(btn)btn.textContent=_theme==='dark'?T[_lang]['theme-dark']:T[_lang]['theme-light'];}
function toggleLang(){_lang=_lang==='id'?'en':'id';applyLang();if(_currentPage==='project'){_quoteTyped=false;startQuote();}}

function copyCode(btn){var pre=btn.parentNode.querySelector('pre');if(!pre)return;navigator.clipboard.writeText(pre.textContent).then(function(){btn.textContent='Copied!';btn.classList.add('copied');setTimeout(function(){btn.textContent='Copy';btn.classList.remove('copied');},2000);});}
function esc(s){return s.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');}
function buildAccordion(data,containerId){var container=document.getElementById(containerId);if(!container)return;var html='';for(var idx=0;idx<data.length;idx++){var item=data[idx];var num=idx+1<10?'0'+(idx+1):''+(idx+1);var bodyHtml='<p class="acc-desc">'+item.desc+'</p>';for(var si=0;si<item.sections.length;si++){var sec=item.sections[si];bodyHtml+='<div class="acc-section"><h4>'+sec.heading+'</h4>';if(sec.steps&&sec.steps.length){bodyHtml+='<ol class="step-list">';for(var ki=0;ki<sec.steps.length;ki++){var sn=ki+1<10?'0'+(ki+1):''+(ki+1);bodyHtml+='<li><span class="step-num">'+sn+'</span><span>'+sec.steps[ki]+'</span></li>';}bodyHtml+='</ol>';}if(sec.code){bodyHtml+='<div class="code-wrap"><div class="code-block"><pre>'+esc(sec.code)+'</pre></div><button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button></div>';}bodyHtml+='</div>';}if(item.note)bodyHtml+='<div class="note-box">&#9888; <strong>Catatan:</strong> '+item.note+'</div>';if(item.tip)bodyHtml+='<div class="tip-box">&#128161; <strong>Tips:</strong> '+item.tip+'</div>';html+='<div class="acc-item" id="acc-'+containerId+'-'+idx+'">';html+='<div class="acc-head" onclick="toggleAcc(\''+containerId+'\','+idx+')">';html+='<span class="acc-num">'+num+'.</span><span class="acc-title">'+item.title+'</span><span class="acc-arrow">&#9660;</span></div>';html+='<div class="acc-body">'+bodyHtml+'</div></div>';}container.innerHTML=html;}
function toggleAcc(cid,idx){var el=document.getElementById('acc-'+cid+'-'+idx);if(!el)return;var wasOpen=el.classList.contains('open');document.querySelectorAll('#'+cid+' .acc-item').forEach(function(a){a.classList.remove('open');});if(!wasOpen)el.classList.add('open');}

{title:'File Sharing (Virt Manager)',desc:'Berbagi file antara Host dan Guest VM menggunakan Virt Manager dengan filesystem 9p/virtio. Memudahkan transfer file tanpa jaringan tambahan.',sections:[{heading:'Install Paket di Host',steps:['Login sebagai root ke komputer host.','Install paket virtualisasi yang diperlukan.','Tambahkan user ke grup libvirt.'],code:'apt-get update\napt-get install qemu-kvm libvirt-daemon-system virt-manager -y\nadduser nizar libvirt\nadduser nizar kvm\nsystemctl enable --now libvirtd'},{heading:'Buat Folder Share di Host',steps:['Buat direktori yang akan dibagikan.','Beri izin penuh agar Guest bisa akses.'],code:'mkdir -p /home/share\nchmod 777 /home/share\necho "Test dari Host" > /home/share/test.txt'},{heading:'Tambah Filesystem di Virt Manager',steps:['Buka Virt Manager -> pilih VM -> Edit -> Virtual Machine Details.','Klik Add Hardware -> Filesystem.','Driver: 9p | Source Path: /home/share | Target Path: hostshare.','Klik Finish -> Apply -> Restart VM.']},{heading:'Mount di dalam Guest VM',steps:['Login root di Guest VM.','Buat direktori tujuan mount.','Mount dari host.','Tambahkan ke /etc/fstab agar auto-mount.'],code:'mkdir -p /mnt/share\nmount -t 9p -o trans=virtio,version=9p2000.L hostshare /mnt/share\nls /mnt/share\n# Auto-mount - tambahkan ke /etc/fstab:\nnano /etc/fstab\nhostshare  /mnt/share  9p  trans=virtio,version=9p2000.L,rw,_netdev  0  0\nmount -a'}],note:'Untuk Debian lama gunakan 9p. virtiofs membutuhkan QEMU 5.0+.'},
{title:'DHCP Server di Debian',desc:'DHCP Server memberikan IP address otomatis ke client menggunakan paket isc-dhcp-server. Tidak perlu setting IP manual di setiap perangkat jaringan.',sections:[{heading:'Set IP Statis Server',steps:['Login sebagai root.','Edit konfigurasi network interface.','Set IP statis agar server punya alamat tetap.'],code:'nano /etc/network/interfaces\n\nauto lo\niface lo inet loopback\n\nauto eth0\niface eth0 inet static\n    address 192.168.10.1\n    netmask 255.255.255.0\n    network 192.168.10.0\n    broadcast 192.168.10.255\n\n/etc/init.d/networking restart\nip a'},{heading:'Install isc-dhcp-server',steps:['Install paket DHCP server.','Pesan FAILED saat install adalah NORMAL.'],code:'apt-get update\napt-get install isc-dhcp-server -y'},{heading:'Konfigurasi dhcpd.conf',steps:['Edit file konfigurasi utama.','Atur range IP, gateway, dan DNS.'],code:'nano /etc/dhcp/dhcpd.conf\n\ndefault-lease-time 600;\nmax-lease-time 7200;\n\nsubnet 192.168.10.0 netmask 255.255.255.0 {\n    range 192.168.10.100 192.168.10.200;\n    option routers 192.168.10.1;\n    option domain-name-servers 8.8.8.8, 8.8.4.4;\n    option broadcast-address 192.168.10.255;\n}'},{heading:'Set Interface & Restart',steps:['Tentukan interface yang melayani DHCP.','Restart dan cek status.'],code:'nano /etc/default/isc-dhcp-server\nINTERFACESv4="eth0"\n\n/etc/init.d/isc-dhcp-server restart\nsystemctl status isc-dhcp-server\ncat /var/lib/dhcp/dhcpd.leases'}],note:'Jika DHCP FAILED, cek penulisan dhcpd.conf. Kesalahan titik koma (;) adalah penyebab paling umum.'},
{title:'SSH Server di Debian',desc:'SSH memungkinkan remote server secara aman melalui koneksi terenkripsi. Dari Windows gunakan PuTTY, dari Linux/Mac cukup terminal.',sections:[{heading:'Install openssh-server',steps:['Cek apakah SSH sudah ada.','Install jika belum.'],code:'dpkg -l | grep openssh-server\napt-get install openssh-server -y'},{heading:'Konfigurasi sshd_config',steps:['Edit file konfigurasi.','Izinkan login root.'],code:'nano /etc/ssh/sshd_config\n# Ubah:\nPort 22\nPermitRootLogin yes\nPasswordAuthentication yes'},{heading:'Restart & Test',steps:['Restart SSH dan test koneksi dari client.'],code:'/etc/init.d/ssh restart\nsystemctl status ssh\nnetstat -tulpn | grep sshd\n\n# Dari client Linux:\nssh root@192.168.1.10\n# Ganti port: ssh root@192.168.1.10 -p 49190'}],tip:'Gunakan PuTTY di Windows: isi Host=IP server, Port=22, SSH -> Open.'},
{title:'SAMBA Server di Debian',desc:'Samba berbagi file ke jaringan Windows menggunakan protokol SMB/CIFS. Client Windows bisa akses folder Debian seperti shared folder Windows biasa.',sections:[{heading:'Install Samba',steps:['Install paket samba.'],code:'apt-get install samba samba-common-bin -y'},{heading:'Buat Folder & Edit smb.conf',steps:['Buat folder share.','Backup config asli.','Tambahkan blok share di akhir smb.conf.'],code:'mkdir -p /home/share\nchmod 777 /home/share\ncp /etc/samba/smb.conf /etc/samba/smb.conf.bak\nnano /etc/samba/smb.conf\n\n# Tambahkan di PALING BAWAH:\n[ShareNizar]\n    path = /home/share\n    browsable = yes\n    writable = yes\n    guest ok = yes\n    read only = no\n    create mask = 0777'},{heading:'Tambah User & Restart',steps:['Buat user Samba jika pakai autentikasi.','Restart dan test.'],code:'smbpasswd -a nizar\n/etc/init.d/smbd restart\ntestparm\n\n# Akses dari Windows:\n# \\\\192.168.1.10\\ShareNizar'}]},
{title:'Webmin',desc:'Webmin adalah panel administrasi server berbasis web. Kelola user, service, DHCP, DNS, firewall melalui browser tanpa perlu hafal semua perintah terminal.',sections:[{heading:'Tambah Repository & Install',steps:['Tambahkan GPG key dan repository resmi.','Install Webmin.'],code:'apt-get install curl gnupg -y\ncurl -fsSL https://download.webmin.com/jcameron-key.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/webmin.gpg\necho "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/webmin.gpg] https://download.webmin.com/download/repository sarge contrib" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/webmin.list\napt-get update && apt-get install webmin -y\nsystemctl enable webmin'},{heading:'Akses dari Browser',steps:['Buka browser, ketik HTTPS port 10000.','Klik Advanced -> Proceed (peringatan SSL normal).','Login: root / password root server.'],code:'# Ketik di browser:\nhttps://192.168.1.10:10000\nufw allow 10000/tcp'}],tip:'Webmin membantu pemula, tapi tetap pelajari terminal untuk pemahaman lebih dalam.'},
{title:'IPTables Port Forwarding',desc:'IPTables adalah firewall bawaan Linux. Port Forwarding meneruskan paket dari satu port/IP ke tujuan lain. Berguna untuk NAT dan berbagi internet ke LAN.',sections:[{heading:'Aktifkan IP Forwarding',steps:['Aktifkan forwarding agar server bisa meneruskan paket antar interface.'],code:'echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward\nnano /etc/sysctl.conf\n# Uncomment: net.ipv4.ip_forward=1\nsysctl -p\ncat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward\n# Output harus: 1'},{heading:'NAT Masquerade',steps:['eth0=WAN, eth1=LAN. Client di LAN bisa akses internet via Debian.'],code:'iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE\niptables -A FORWARD -i eth1 -o eth0 -j ACCEPT\niptables -A FORWARD -i eth0 -o eth1 -m state --state RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT\niptables -t nat -L -n -v'},{heading:'DNAT & Simpan Rule',steps:['Forward port ke server internal.','Simpan rule agar tidak hilang saat reboot.'],code:'iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -i eth0 -p tcp --dport 8080 -j DNAT --to-destination 192.168.10.100:80\niptables -A FORWARD -p tcp -d 192.168.10.100 --dport 80 -j ACCEPT\n\napt-get install iptables-persistent -y\nnetfilter-persistent save'}],note:'Hati-hati konfigurasi IPTables via SSH! Rule salah bisa memblokir koneksi SSH.'},
{title:'Apache Web Server',desc:'Apache adalah web server paling populer. Satu server bisa menjalankan banyak website sekaligus menggunakan Virtual Host. Mendukung PHP, SSL, dan banyak modul.',sections:[{heading:'Install & Virtual Host',steps:['Install Apache2.','Buat folder website dan halaman HTML.','Buat konfigurasi virtual host.','Aktifkan dan reload Apache.'],code:'apt-get install apache2 -y\nsystemctl enable apache2\n\nmkdir -p /var/www/nizar\nnano /var/www/nizar/index.html\n# Isi: <html><body><h1>Web Server Nizar!</h1></body></html>\n\nnano /etc/apache2/sites-available/nizar.conf\n# Isi:\n# <VirtualHost *:80>\n#     ServerName nizar.local\n#     DocumentRoot /var/www/nizar\n#     ErrorLog /var/log/apache2/nizar-error.log\n#     CustomLog /var/log/apache2/nizar-access.log combined\n#     <Directory /var/www/nizar>\n#         AllowOverride All\n#         Require all granted\n#     </Directory>\n# </VirtualHost>\n\na2ensite nizar.conf\na2dissite 000-default.conf\na2enmod rewrite\napache2ctl configtest\nsystemctl reload apache2'}],tip:'Install PHP: apt-get install php libapache2-mod-php -y untuk website berbasis PHP (WordPress, Laravel).'},
{title:'Debian sebagai Router',desc:'Debian dengan dua network interface bisa menjadi router software. eth0 untuk WAN (internet), eth1 untuk LAN (client). Client LAN berbagi koneksi internet melalui Debian.',sections:[{heading:'Konfigurasi IP & Forwarding',steps:['eth0 = DHCP dari internet. eth1 = IP statis sebagai gateway client.','Aktifkan IP forwarding.'],code:'nano /etc/network/interfaces\n\nauto eth0\niface eth0 inet dhcp\n\nauto eth1\niface eth1 inet static\n    address 192.168.10.1\n    netmask 255.255.255.0\n\n/etc/init.d/networking restart\n\nnano /etc/sysctl.conf\n# Uncomment: net.ipv4.ip_forward=1\nsysctl -p'},{heading:'NAT & Konfigurasi Client',steps:['Tambahkan rule NAT masquerade.','Set IP statis di client dengan gateway ke Debian.'],code:'iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE\niptables -A FORWARD -i eth1 -o eth0 -j ACCEPT\niptables -A FORWARD -i eth0 -o eth1 -m state --state RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT\napt-get install iptables-persistent -y && netfilter-persistent save\n\n# Di client:\ngateway 192.168.10.1\nping 8.8.8.8'}]},
{title:'DNS Server di Debian',desc:'BIND9 mengubah nama domain menjadi IP (forward) dan sebaliknya (reverse). Bisa membuat domain custom untuk jaringan lokal seperti nizar.local.',sections:[{heading:'Install BIND9 & Konfigurasi Zone',steps:['Install BIND9.','Tambahkan deklarasi zone di named.conf.local.'],code:'apt-get install bind9 bind9utils dnsutils -y\nsystemctl enable bind9\n\nnano /etc/bind/named.conf.local\n\nzone "nizar.local" {\n    type master;\n    file "/etc/bind/zones/db.nizar.local";\n};\n\nzone "10.168.192.in-addr.arpa" {\n    type master;\n    file "/etc/bind/zones/db.192.168.10";\n};'},{heading:'Buat File Zone & Restart',steps:['Buat folder zones dan file zone forward.','Verifikasi dan restart BIND9.'],code:'mkdir -p /etc/bind/zones\ncp /etc/bind/db.local /etc/bind/zones/db.nizar.local\nnano /etc/bind/zones/db.nizar.local\n# Isi:\n$TTL 604800\n@ IN SOA ns1.nizar.local. root.nizar.local. ( 2 604800 86400 2419200 604800 )\n@ IN NS ns1.nizar.local.\nns1 IN A 192.168.10.1\nwww IN A 192.168.10.10\n\nnamed-checkconf\nnamed-checkzone nizar.local /etc/bind/zones/db.nizar.local\n/etc/init.d/bind9 restart\nnslookup www.nizar.local 192.168.10.1'}],note:'Serial number HARUS di-increment setiap ada perubahan di file zone.'},
{title:'Nginx Load Balancing',desc:'Nginx sebagai load balancer mendistribusikan traffic ke beberapa backend server. Jika satu server down, traffic otomatis ke server lain dengan metode round-robin, least_conn, atau ip_hash.',sections:[{heading:'Install & Konfigurasi',steps:['Install Nginx.','Buat konfigurasi upstream dan server block.','Test dan reload.'],code:'apt-get install nginx -y\nsystemctl enable nginx\n\nnano /etc/nginx/conf.d/loadbalancer.conf\n\nupstream web_backend {\n    least_conn;\n    server 192.168.10.11:80 weight=3;\n    server 192.168.10.12:80 weight=1;\n    server 192.168.10.13:80 backup;\n}\n\nserver {\n    listen 80;\n    server_name lb.nizar.local;\n    location / {\n        proxy_pass http://web_backend;\n        proxy_set_header Host $host;\n        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;\n    }\n}\n\nnginx -t\nsystemctl reload nginx\ntail -f /var/log/nginx/access.log'}],tip:'Gunakan ip_hash agar client yang sama selalu ke server yang sama (session persistence).'},
{title:'OpenVPN dengan Script',desc:'OpenVPN adalah VPN open-source yang aman. Script instalasi otomatis mempercepat setup - cocok untuk membangun VPN server sendiri tanpa konfigurasi manual panjang.',sections:[{heading:'Download & Jalankan Script',steps:['Install curl.','Download dan jalankan script openvpn-install dari Angristan.'],code:'apt-get install curl -y\ncurl ifconfig.me\n\ncurl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/angristan/openvpn-install/master/openvpn-install.sh\nchmod +x openvpn-install.sh\nbash openvpn-install.sh'},{heading:'Jawab Pertanyaan & Distribusi File',steps:['IP: Enter (otomatis). Protocol: 1 (UDP). Port: Enter. DNS: 3. Client name: nizar-laptop.','Copy file .ovpn ke client.'],code:'ls /root/*.ovpn\ncp /root/nizar-laptop.ovpn /home/nizar/\nsystemctl status openvpn@server\n\n# Koneksi dari client Linux:\napt-get install openvpn -y\nopenvpn --config nizar-laptop.ovpn\nip a  # Cek interface tun0'}],tip:'Simpan .ovpn dengan aman! Siapapun yang punya file ini bisa connect ke VPN kamu.'},
{title:'HTTPS di Apache',desc:'HTTPS mengenkripsi koneksi browser-server menggunakan SSL/TLS. Self-signed untuk lab, Lets Encrypt untuk domain publik (gratis & auto-renewal setiap 90 hari).',sections:[{heading:'Aktifkan SSL & Buat Sertifikat Self-Signed',steps:['Aktifkan modul SSL.','Generate sertifikat self-signed.'],code:'a2enmod ssl headers\nsystemctl restart apache2\n\nmkdir -p /etc/apache2/ssl\nopenssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 \\\n    -keyout /etc/apache2/ssl/nizar.key \\\n    -out /etc/apache2/ssl/nizar.crt\n# Isi: ID / Jawa Timur / Blitar / Nizar Lab / 192.168.1.10'},{heading:'Konfigurasi & Aktifkan HTTPS',steps:['Buat konfigurasi virtual host HTTPS dengan redirect dari HTTP.'],code:'nano /etc/apache2/sites-available/nizar-ssl.conf\n\n<VirtualHost *:80>\n    ServerName nizar.local\n    Redirect permanent / https://nizar.local/\n</VirtualHost>\n\n<VirtualHost *:443>\n    ServerName nizar.local\n    DocumentRoot /var/www/nizar\n    SSLEngine on\n    SSLCertificateFile /etc/apache2/ssl/nizar.crt\n    SSLCertificateKeyFile /etc/apache2/ssl/nizar.key\n    SSLProtocol all -SSLv2 -SSLv3\n    <Directory /var/www/nizar>\n        AllowOverride All\n        Require all granted\n    </Directory>\n    ErrorLog /var/log/apache2/nizar-ssl-error.log\n    CustomLog /var/log/apache2/nizar-ssl-access.log combined\n</VirtualHost>\n\na2ensite nizar-ssl.conf\napache2ctl configtest\nsystemctl restart apache2'}],note:"Self-signed menyebabkan peringatan browser. Untuk produksi gunakan Lets Encrypt: apt-get install certbot python3-certbot-apache -y"},
{title:'Mail Server (Postfix + Dovecot + Roundcube)',desc:'Mail server lengkap: Postfix (SMTP), Dovecot (IMAP/POP3), Roundcube (webmail). Untuk lab jaringan lokal - simulasi email server seperti di dunia nyata.',sections:[{heading:'Install & Konfigurasi Postfix',steps:['Install Postfix. Dialog: Internet Site, mail name: mail.nizar.local.'],code:'apt-get install postfix -y\n\nnano /etc/postfix/main.cf\n# Pastikan:\nmyhostname = mail.nizar.local\nmydomain = nizar.local\nmyorigin = $mydomain\ninet_interfaces = all\nmydestination = $myhostname, localhost.$mydomain, localhost, $mydomain\nmynetworks = 127.0.0.0/8, 192.168.10.0/24\nhome_mailbox = Maildir/\n\n/etc/init.d/postfix restart'},{heading:'Install Dovecot & Roundcube',steps:['Install Dovecot untuk IMAP/POP3.','Install Roundcube webmail.'],code:'apt-get install dovecot-imapd dovecot-pop3d -y\nnano /etc/dovecot/conf.d/10-mail.conf\n# mail_location = maildir:~/Maildir\nnano /etc/dovecot/conf.d/10-auth.conf\n# disable_plaintext_auth = no\n# auth_mechanisms = plain login\n/etc/init.d/dovecot restart\n\napt-get install apache2 php php-mysql mariadb-server roundcube roundcube-mysql -y\na2enconf roundcube && systemctl reload apache2\n\n# Akses: http://192.168.10.10/roundcube'}],note:'Konfigurasi ini untuk lab lokal. Email internet butuh IP publik, domain resmi, dan MX record.'},
{title:'FTP & FTPS Server (ProFTPD)',desc:'ProFTPD adalah FTP server fleksibel untuk Debian. FTPS menambahkan enkripsi SSL/TLS sehingga lebih aman dari FTP biasa yang mengirim data tanpa enkripsi.',sections:[{heading:'Install & Konfigurasi Dasar',steps:['Install ProFTPD. Dialog: pilih standalone.','Set konfigurasi dasar.'],code:'apt-get install proftpd openssl -y\n\nnano /etc/proftpd/proftpd.conf\n# Ubah:\nServerName    "Nizar FTP Server"\nDefaultRoot   ~\nRootLogin     off\nPassivePorts  49152 65534\n\nadduser --shell /usr/sbin/nologin ftpuser\nmkdir -p /home/ftpuser/upload\nchmod 755 /home/ftpuser\nchmod 777 /home/ftpuser/upload'},{heading:'Aktifkan FTPS & Test',steps:['Generate sertifikat SSL.','Aktifkan modul TLS dan test koneksi.'],code:'mkdir -p /etc/proftpd/ssl\nopenssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 \\\n    -keyout /etc/proftpd/ssl/proftpd.key \\\n    -out /etc/proftpd/ssl/proftpd.crt\n\nnano /etc/proftpd/proftpd.conf\n# Tambahkan di akhir:\n<IfModule mod_tls.c>\n    TLSEngine on\n    TLSRSACertificateFile /etc/proftpd/ssl/proftpd.crt\n    TLSRSACertificateKeyFile /etc/proftpd/ssl/proftpd.key\n    TLSVerifyClient off\n    TLSRequired on\n</IfModule>\n\n/etc/init.d/proftpd restart\nftp 192.168.1.10'}]},
{title:'NAT Gateway (DHCP + Router)',desc:'VM Debian berfungsi ganda: DHCP Server (beri IP otomatis ke client) + Gateway NAT (berbagi internet ke LAN). Topologi ideal untuk lab jaringan dengan banyak VM.',sections:[{heading:'Konfigurasi Lengkap',steps:['eth0=WAN (DHCP dari internet). eth1=LAN statis sebagai gateway.','Aktifkan IP forwarding dan NAT.','Install dan konfigurasi DHCP server.'],code:'nano /etc/network/interfaces\nauto eth0\niface eth0 inet dhcp\nauto eth1\niface eth1 inet static\n    address 192.168.10.1\n    netmask 255.255.255.0\n/etc/init.d/networking restart\n\nnano /etc/sysctl.conf\n# Uncomment: net.ipv4.ip_forward=1\nsysctl -p\n\niptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE\niptables -A FORWARD -i eth1 -o eth0 -j ACCEPT\niptables -A FORWARD -i eth0 -o eth1 -m state --state RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT\napt-get install iptables-persistent -y && netfilter-persistent save\n\napt-get install isc-dhcp-server -y\nnano /etc/default/isc-dhcp-server\nINTERFACESv4="eth1"\n\nnano /etc/dhcp/dhcpd.conf\nsubnet 192.168.10.0 netmask 255.255.255.0 {\n    range 192.168.10.100 192.168.10.200;\n    option routers 192.168.10.1;\n    option domain-name-servers 8.8.8.8;\n}\n/etc/init.d/isc-dhcp-server restart\n\n# Test dari client:\nping 192.168.10.1\nping 8.8.8.8'}],tip:'Urutan konfigurasi: (1) IP statis eth1 -> (2) IP forwarding -> (3) IPTables NAT -> (4) DHCP server.'},
{title:'Ansible Deploy Web Server',desc:'Ansible mengotomasi konfigurasi banyak server sekaligus via SSH tanpa install agent. Satu perintah deploy Nginx ke puluhan server sekaligus menggunakan Playbook YAML.',sections:[{heading:'Install, Inventory & SSH Key',steps:['Install Ansible di Control Node.','Buat inventory dan copy SSH key ke semua target server.'],code:'apt-get install ansible -y\nansible --version\n\nnano /etc/ansible/hosts\n[webservers]\nweb1 ansible_host=192.168.10.11 ansible_user=root\nweb2 ansible_host=192.168.10.12 ansible_user=root\n\nssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096\nssh-copy-id root@192.168.10.11\nssh-copy-id root@192.168.10.12\n\nansible webservers -m ping'},{heading:'Buat & Jalankan Playbook',steps:['Buat playbook YAML untuk deploy Nginx.','Jalankan dan verifikasi.'],code:'nano /root/deploy-nginx.yml\n---\n- name: Deploy Nginx\n  hosts: webservers\n  become: yes\n  tasks:\n    - name: Install Nginx\n      apt: name=nginx state=present update_cache=yes\n    - name: Start Nginx\n      service: name=nginx state=started enabled=yes\n    - name: Buat index.html\n      copy:\n        dest: /var/www/html/index.html\n        content: "<h1>Server: {{ inventory_hostname }}</h1>"\n\nansible-playbook /root/deploy-nginx.yml -v\ncurl http://192.168.10.11'}],tip:'Ansible idempotent - aman dijalankan berkali-kali tanpa efek samping.'}
];

var mikrotikData=[
{title:'Basic Command MikroTik',desc:'Perintah dasar CLI MikroTik yang wajib dikuasai. Semua konfigurasi bisa dilakukan via terminal Winbox atau SSH ke MikroTik.',sections:[{heading:'Navigasi & Info Sistem',steps:['Login via Winbox atau SSH ke MikroTik.','Gunakan perintah untuk melihat info dan navigasi.'],code:'/system identity print\n/system resource print\n/interface print\n/ip address print\n/ip route print\n/ip dns print\n\n# Navigasi CLI:\n/ip address\nprint\nback\n/'},{heading:'Konfigurasi IP & Route',steps:['Set IP address pada interface.','Set default route dan DNS.'],code:'/ip address add address=192.168.1.1/24 interface=ether1\n/ip route add dst-address=0.0.0.0/0 gateway=192.168.1.254\n/ip dns set servers=8.8.8.8,8.8.4.4\n/ip dns set allow-remote-requests=yes\n/ping 8.8.8.8'},{heading:'Backup & Restore',steps:['Backup konfigurasi sebelum perubahan besar.'],code:'# Backup:\n/system backup save name=backup-hari-ini\n/export file=config-export\n\n# Restore:\n/system backup load name=backup-hari-ini\n\n# Reset:\n/system reset-configuration no-defaults=yes skip-backup=yes'}]},
{title:'Load Balance PCC',desc:'Per Connection Classifier mendistribusikan koneksi ke beberapa ISP secara merata berdasarkan source/destination IP dan port. Ideal untuk 2+ koneksi ISP.',sections:[{heading:'Topologi',steps:['ISP1 via ether1 (GW: 10.0.1.1).','ISP2 via ether2 (GW: 10.0.2.1).','LAN di ether3 (192.168.10.0/24).']},{heading:'Konfigurasi PCC',steps:['Buat mangle rule untuk PCC.','Buat routing table dan rule NAT.'],code:'/ip firewall mangle\nadd chain=prerouting dst-address-type=!local in-interface=ether3 per-connection-classifier=both-addresses-and-ports:2/0 action=mark-connection new-connection-mark=isp1\nadd chain=prerouting dst-address-type=!local in-interface=ether3 per-connection-classifier=both-addresses-and-ports:2/1 action=mark-connection new-connection-mark=isp2\nadd chain=prerouting connection-mark=isp1 in-interface=ether3 action=mark-routing new-routing-mark=to-isp1\nadd chain=prerouting connection-mark=isp2 in-interface=ether3 action=mark-routing new-routing-mark=to-isp2\n\n/ip route\nadd gateway=10.0.1.1 routing-table=to-isp1\nadd gateway=10.0.2.1 routing-table=to-isp2\nadd gateway=10.0.1.1,10.0.2.1\n\n/ip firewall nat\nadd chain=srcnat out-interface=ether1 action=masquerade\nadd chain=srcnat out-interface=ether2 action=masquerade'}]},
{title:'VLAN MikroTik',desc:'VLAN memisahkan traffic dalam jaringan fisik menjadi beberapa jaringan virtual yang terisolasi. Berguna untuk memisahkan traffic antar departemen.',sections:[{heading:'Buat VLAN & DHCP per VLAN',steps:['Buat VLAN interface di atas interface fisik.','Set IP dan buat DHCP pool untuk tiap VLAN.'],code:'/interface vlan add name=vlan10 vlan-id=10 interface=ether2\n/interface vlan add name=vlan20 vlan-id=20 interface=ether2\n\n/ip address add address=192.168.10.1/24 interface=vlan10\n/ip address add address=192.168.20.1/24 interface=vlan20\n\n/ip pool add name=pool-vlan10 ranges=192.168.10.100-192.168.10.200\n/ip pool add name=pool-vlan20 ranges=192.168.20.100-192.168.20.200\n\n/ip dhcp-server add name=dhcp-vlan10 interface=vlan10 address-pool=pool-vlan10\n/ip dhcp-server add name=dhcp-vlan20 interface=vlan20 address-pool=pool-vlan20\n\n/ip dhcp-server network add address=192.168.10.0/24 gateway=192.168.10.1 dns-server=8.8.8.8\n/ip dhcp-server network add address=192.168.20.0/24 gateway=192.168.20.1 dns-server=8.8.8.8\n\n/interface vlan print'}]},
{title:'Web Proxy MikroTik',desc:'Web Proxy menyimpan cache halaman web untuk mempercepat akses dan menghemat bandwidth. Bisa digunakan untuk filtering dan blokir website.',sections:[{heading:'Aktifkan Web Proxy & Transparent',steps:['Aktifkan proxy dan set sebagai transparent proxy.','Blokir website tertentu.'],code:'/ip proxy set enabled=yes\n/ip proxy set port=8080\n/ip proxy set max-cache-size=unlimited\n/ip proxy print\n\n# Transparent proxy:\n/ip firewall nat add chain=dstnat src-address=192.168.1.0/24 protocol=tcp dst-port=80 action=redirect to-ports=8080\n\n# Blokir website:\n/ip proxy access add dst-host=*.youtube.com action=deny\n/ip proxy access add dst-host=*.tiktok.com action=deny\n\n/ip proxy access print'}]},
{title:'Routing (Static & Dynamic OSPF)',desc:'Routing menentukan jalur pengiriman paket antar jaringan. Static routing dikonfigurasi manual, OSPF otomatis mempelajari route dari router tetangga.',sections:[{heading:'Static Routing',steps:['Tambahkan route ke jaringan tujuan.'],code:'# Route ke 192.168.20.0/24 via gateway 10.0.0.2\n/ip route add dst-address=192.168.20.0/24 gateway=10.0.0.2\n/ip route add dst-address=0.0.0.0/0 gateway=10.0.0.1\n/ip route print\n/ping 192.168.20.1'},{heading:'Dynamic Routing - OSPF',steps:['OSPF otomatis mempelajari route dari router tetangga.'],code:'/routing ospf instance add name=default router-id=1.1.1.1\n/routing ospf area add name=backbone area-id=0.0.0.0 instance=default\n/routing ospf interface-template add interfaces=ether1 area=backbone\n\n/routing ospf neighbor print\n/routing ospf route print'}]},
{title:'Firewall MikroTik',desc:'Firewall MikroTik melindungi jaringan dari akses tidak sah. Chain INPUT (ke router), FORWARD (lewat router), OUTPUT (dari router).',sections:[{heading:'Basic Firewall Rules',steps:['Tambahkan rule dasar keamanan.'],code:'/ip firewall filter\nadd chain=input connection-state=established,related action=accept\nadd chain=forward connection-state=established,related action=accept\nadd chain=input connection-state=invalid action=drop\nadd chain=input protocol=icmp action=accept\nadd chain=input src-address=192.168.1.0/24 action=accept\nadd chain=input action=drop\n\n# Blokir Winbox dari internet:\nadd chain=input in-interface=ether1 dst-port=8291 protocol=tcp action=drop\n\n# Proteksi brute force SSH:\nadd chain=input protocol=tcp dst-port=22 connection-state=new action=add-src-to-address-list address-list=ssh-brute address-list-timeout=1m\nadd chain=input src-address-list=ssh-brute action=drop\n\n/ip firewall filter print'}]},
{title:'Hotspot MikroTik',desc:'Hotspot menyediakan halaman login sebelum user bisa akses internet. Cocok untuk warnet, cafe, hotel, kampus, dan area publik.',sections:[{heading:'Setup Hotspot & Manajemen User',steps:['Setup via Winbox: IP -> Hotspot -> Hotspot Setup.','Pilih interface, set pool IP, DNS, buat user pertama.','Kelola user hotspot.'],code:'/ip hotspot setup\n# Interface: ether2\n# Local address: 192.168.2.1/24\n# Pool: 192.168.2.2-192.168.2.254\n# DNS: 8.8.8.8\n# DNS name: hotspot.nizar.local\n# User: admin/admin\n\n# Buat user hotspot:\n/ip hotspot user add name=user1 password=pass1 profile=default\n/ip hotspot user add name=vip password=vip123 limit-uptime=2h\n\n# Cek aktif:\n/ip hotspot active print\n/ip hotspot user print'}]},
{title:'Memisah Traffic Game vs Browsing',desc:'Prioritaskan traffic game online agar lag minimal menggunakan Mangle + Queue Tree. Game mendapat prioritas tinggi, browsing tetap jalan normal.',sections:[{heading:'Mangle & Queue Tree',steps:['Tandai traffic game berdasarkan port UDP.','Buat Queue Tree dengan prioritas berbeda.'],code:'/ip firewall mangle\nadd chain=prerouting dst-port=5000-5200,10000-10099,27015-27030 protocol=udp action=mark-connection new-connection-mark=game-conn\nadd chain=prerouting connection-mark=game-conn action=mark-packet new-packet-mark=game-traffic\nadd chain=prerouting src-address=192.168.1.0/24 action=mark-connection new-connection-mark=browse-conn\nadd chain=prerouting connection-mark=browse-conn action=mark-packet new-packet-mark=browse-traffic\n\n# Queue Tree:\n/queue tree add name=total parent=global max-limit=20M\n/queue tree add name=game parent=total packet-mark=game-traffic priority=1 max-limit=15M\n/queue tree add name=browsing parent=total packet-mark=browse-traffic priority=7 max-limit=20M\n\n/queue tree print'}]}

var ciscoData=[
{title:'Dasar Jaringan & Perangkat',desc:'Mengenal perangkat jaringan di Cisco Packet Tracer: Router, Switch, Hub, PC, Server, dan jenis kabel. Fondasi sebelum mulai konfigurasi.',sections:[{heading:'Jenis Perangkat',steps:['Router: menghubungkan jaringan berbeda, membuat routing decision di Layer 3.','Switch: menghubungkan perangkat dalam satu LAN, bekerja di Layer 2 (MAC address).','Hub: seperti switch tapi broadcast semua traffic ke semua port (sudah jarang dipakai).','PC/Server: end device, bisa dikonfigurasi IP, DNS, HTTP, FTP di Packet Tracer.']},{heading:'Jenis Kabel & Cara Ingat',steps:['Straight-through: PC ke Switch, Router ke Switch (beda jenis perangkat).','Crossover: PC ke PC, Switch ke Switch, Router ke Router (sama jenis perangkat).','Serial: menghubungkan Router ke Router (WAN link, butuh clock rate di DCE).','Console: konfigurasi langsung via port console pakai kabel rollover.'],code:'# Cara mudah ingat:\n# Beda perangkat -> Straight (lurus)\n# Sama perangkat -> Cross (silang)\n# Di Packet Tracer baru bisa pakai auto-detect (kilat)\n\n# Clock rate di serial interface (sisi DCE):\nR1(config-if)# clock rate 64000'}]},
{title:'Konfigurasi Dasar Perangkat',desc:'Konfigurasi dasar wajib di setiap router dan switch Cisco: hostname, password, banner, IP address, dan save konfigurasi.',sections:[{heading:'Mode CLI & Konfigurasi Dasar',steps:['User EXEC: Router> | Privileged EXEC: Router# (ketik enable)','Global Config: Router(config)# (ketik configure terminal)','Interface Config: Router(config-if)# (ketik interface fa0/0)'],code:'Router> enable\nRouter# configure terminal\nRouter(config)# hostname R1\nR1(config)# enable secret cisco123\nR1(config)# line console 0\nR1(config-line)# password console123\nR1(config-line)# login\nR1(config-line)# exit\nR1(config)# banner motd # Authorized Access Only! #\nR1(config)# service password-encryption\nR1(config)# no ip domain-lookup\nR1(config)# end\nR1# write memory'},{heading:'Konfigurasi IP Interface',steps:['Set IP address dan aktifkan interface router.'],code:'R1# configure terminal\nR1(config)# interface fastEthernet 0/0\nR1(config-if)# ip address 192.168.1.1 255.255.255.0\nR1(config-if)# no shutdown\nR1(config-if)# description LAN Interface\nR1(config-if)# exit\n\nR1# show ip interface brief\nR1# show interfaces fa0/0\nR1# show running-config'}]},
{title:'VLAN & Trunking',desc:'VLAN memisahkan traffic dalam switch. Trunking memungkinkan satu kabel membawa traffic dari banyak VLAN antara switch. Inter-VLAN routing via Router-on-a-Stick.',sections:[{heading:'VLAN di Switch',steps:['Buat VLAN dan assign port ke VLAN.'],code:'SW1# configure terminal\nSW1(config)# vlan 10\nSW1(config-vlan)# name IT-Department\nSW1(config-vlan)# exit\nSW1(config)# vlan 20\nSW1(config-vlan)# name Finance\nSW1(config-vlan)# exit\n\nSW1(config)# interface fa0/1\nSW1(config-if)# switchport mode access\nSW1(config-if)# switchport access vlan 10\nSW1(config-if)# exit\n\nSW1# show vlan brief'},{heading:'Trunk & Inter-VLAN Routing',steps:['Set port trunk antar switch.','Konfigurasi sub-interface di router untuk routing antar VLAN.'],code:'# Trunk port:\nSW1(config)# interface fa0/24\nSW1(config-if)# switchport mode trunk\nSW1(config-if)# switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20\nSW1# show interfaces trunk\n\n# Router-on-a-Stick:\nR1(config)# interface fa0/0\nR1(config-if)# no shutdown\nR1(config)# interface fa0/0.10\nR1(config-subif)# encapsulation dot1Q 10\nR1(config-subif)# ip address 192.168.10.1 255.255.255.0\nR1(config)# interface fa0/0.20\nR1(config-subif)# encapsulation dot1Q 20\nR1(config-subif)# ip address 192.168.20.1 255.255.255.0'}]},
{title:'Routing (Static, RIP, OSPF, EIGRP)',desc:'Routing menentukan jalur terbaik pengiriman paket. Static manual, dynamic (RIP, OSPF, EIGRP) otomatis mempelajari route dari router tetangga.',sections:[{heading:'Static Routing & Default Route',steps:['Tambahkan route ke setiap network tujuan secara manual.'],code:'# Static route:\nR1(config)# ip route 192.168.2.0 255.255.255.0 10.0.0.2\nR1(config)# ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.0.0.1\nR1# show ip route'},{heading:'RIP v2',steps:['RIP sederhana untuk jaringan kecil.'],code:'R1(config)# router rip\nR1(config-router)# version 2\nR1(config-router)# no auto-summary\nR1(config-router)# network 192.168.1.0\nR1(config-router)# network 10.0.0.0\nR1# show ip rip database'},{heading:'OSPF & EIGRP',steps:['OSPF untuk jaringan besar, EIGRP protokol Cisco.'],code:'# OSPF:\nR1(config)# router ospf 1\nR1(config-router)# router-id 1.1.1.1\nR1(config-router)# network 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255 area 0\nR1# show ip ospf neighbor\n\n# EIGRP:\nR1(config)# router eigrp 100\nR1(config-router)# network 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255\nR1(config-router)# no auto-summary\nR1# show ip eigrp neighbors'}]},
{title:'DHCP, DNS & HTTP/FTP Server',desc:'Packet Tracer menyediakan server simulasi yang bisa dikonfigurasi sebagai DHCP, DNS, HTTP, dan FTP server untuk kebutuhan lab jaringan.',sections:[{heading:'DHCP di Router Cisco',steps:['Buat DHCP pool langsung di router.'],code:'R1(config)# ip dhcp excluded-address 192.168.1.1 192.168.1.10\nR1(config)# ip dhcp pool LAN-POOL\nR1(dhcp-config)# network 192.168.1.0 255.255.255.0\nR1(dhcp-config)# default-router 192.168.1.1\nR1(dhcp-config)# dns-server 8.8.8.8\nR1(dhcp-config)# lease 1\nR1# show ip dhcp binding'},{heading:'Server Packet Tracer',steps:['Buka Server device -> Services -> pilih layanan.','DHCP: aktifkan, set pool, gateway, DNS.','DNS: aktifkan, tambahkan A Record (nama -> IP).','HTTP: aktifkan, edit index.html.','FTP: aktifkan, tambahkan username dan password.']}]},
{title:'NAT (Static, Dynamic, PAT)',desc:'NAT mengubah IP private menjadi IP public agar jaringan private bisa akses internet. PAT (NAT Overload) paling umum digunakan karena hemat IP public.',sections:[{heading:'Static NAT & PAT',steps:['Static NAT: satu IP private ke satu IP public.','PAT: banyak IP private berbagi satu IP public.'],code:'# Static NAT:\nR1(config)# ip nat inside source static 192.168.1.10 203.0.113.10\nR1(config)# interface fa0/0\nR1(config-if)# ip nat inside\nR1(config)# interface serial0/0\nR1(config-if)# ip nat outside\nR1# show ip nat translations\n\n# PAT (NAT Overload):\nR1(config)# access-list 1 permit 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255\nR1(config)# ip nat inside source list 1 interface serial0/0 overload\nR1(config)# interface fa0/0\nR1(config-if)# ip nat inside\nR1(config)# interface serial0/0\nR1(config-if)# ip nat outside\nR1# show ip nat translations'}]},
{title:'ACL (Standard & Extended)',desc:'ACL memfilter traffic berdasarkan IP dan port. Standard ACL cek source IP saja (nomor 1-99), Extended ACL cek source + destination + protocol + port (100-199).',sections:[{heading:'Standard & Extended ACL',steps:['Standard ACL tempatkan dekat TUJUAN.','Extended ACL tempatkan dekat SUMBER.'],code:'# Standard ACL:\nR1(config)# access-list 10 permit 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255\nR1(config)# access-list 10 deny any\nR1(config)# interface fa0/1\nR1(config-if)# ip access-group 10 out\nR1# show access-lists\n\n# Extended ACL (blokir HTTP dari LAN ke server):\nR1(config)# access-list 100 deny tcp 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.0.0.10 eq 80\nR1(config)# access-list 100 permit ip any any\nR1(config)# interface fa0/0\nR1(config-if)# ip access-group 100 in\nR1# show access-lists 100'}]},
{title:'IoT di Packet Tracer',desc:'Cisco Packet Tracer mendukung simulasi IoT dengan berbagai perangkat pintar yang dikontrol melalui jaringan via IoT Server.',sections:[{heading:'Konfigurasi IoT',steps:['Tambahkan perangkat IoT ke topology.','Hubungkan ke Home Gateway atau Router.','Di IoT Server: Services -> IoT -> aktifkan.','Di perangkat IoT: Config -> IoT Server -> masukkan IP server.'],code:'# Di IoT Server:\n# Services -> IoT -> ON\n# Username: admin, Password: admin\n\n# Monitor via browser:\n# http://[IP-IoT-Server]/IoT\n\n# Perangkat yang tersedia:\n# Lampu, AC, kunci pintu, sensor gerak\n# Thermostat, CCTV, humidity sensor'}]},
{title:'Wireless (Access Point & Keamanan WiFi)',desc:'Konfigurasi Access Point di Packet Tracer untuk jaringan WiFi. Termasuk SSID, enkripsi WPA2, dan tips keamanan wireless.',sections:[{heading:'Setup Access Point & Keamanan',steps:['Tambahkan Wireless Router ke topology.','Konfigurasi SSID dan autentikasi WPA2.','Set di client WiFi agar bisa connect.'],code:'# Di Wireless Router -> Config -> Wireless:\nSSID: Nizar-WiFi\nChannel: 6\nAuthentication: WPA2 Personal\nPSK Pass Phrase: nizar12345678\n\n# Di client (laptop):\n# Config -> Wireless0\n# SSID: Nizar-WiFi\n# Authentication: WPA2-PSK\n# PSK Pass Phrase: nizar12345678\n\n# Tips keamanan WiFi:\n# 1. Selalu WPA2/WPA3, JANGAN WEP\n# 2. Password minimal 12 karakter\n# 3. Nonaktifkan SSID Broadcast\n# 4. Aktifkan MAC Filtering\n# 5. Pisahkan Guest Network'}]}
